claims.claim: The incoming displacement formula is exact under diagonal overdamped endpoint response, equal and opposite net forces, reproducible reversible branches, and complete span closure.
claims.excluded_inference: Physical validity or ZnS endpoint parameters

claims.claim: Published light-assisted ZnS/GaP glide does not acquire the required same-loop paired full-arm forward and return response.
A neutral full screw arm contains Zn30 and S30 partials; the mixed Zn arm contains Zn30 and Zn90 partials.
claims.implication: Neutrality of the full screw does not establish optical insensitivity; both arms share a potentially light-sensitive Zn30 component.

claims.claim: Partial-selective Zn90 excitation is a concrete spectral-brake hypothesis for changing the mixed/screw response ratio.
claims.published_anchor: Room-temperature absorption feature assigned to Zn90 around 2.24 eV; full-arm geometry excludes Zn90 from neutral screw.
claims.excluded_inference: 2.24 eV PLE excitation or mobility switching was measured at350 C

claims.claim: The room-temperature spectral lead does not certify selectivity at the350 C glide temperature.
claims.excluded_inference: GaP-to-ZnS carrier transfer is known to dominate, or spectral control is proved impossible

claims.claim: Electric-field polarity already controls reversible charged30 partial motion in ZnS, with retained displaced positions at zero bias over the observation interval.
claims.excluded_inference: Full surface half-loop rigid translation, closed slipped area, heated ZnS/GaP coefficients, defect removal or qualified device improvement

claims.claim: Direct generalized drive plus shape-force control could produce fixed-span translation without a mobility ratio switch.
conditions: stable dissociation width and loop topology
claims.excluded_inference: Published partial motion has already acquired the needed full-arm force interface

claims.claim: Optimized stress-only motion need not vanish at one fixed optical state when response ratios depend on force.
Phase swap is not generally exact displacement reversal with direction-dependent branches; the four-cycle sum identity is the appropriate reproducibility check.
The closed shape cycle has positive glide dissipation at finite motion time, and large displacement contrast alone can hide vanishing throughput.
claims.excluded_inference: The bound includes state switching, wall-plug, heaters, metrology, preparation, failure or device qualification costs

decisive_next_acquisition: Same-loop four-branch full-arm response under safe reverse loading, or measured direct-drive full-loop shape servo, at one actual coupled physical operating regime.
stop_rules: One full arm cannot move reversibly in the declared admissible window.
Contraction or field actuation produces damage, multiplication, twinning, persistent dissociation-width change, or unclosed shape.
Independent response bounds rule out the preregistered useful retained drift.
Matched optimized mechanical, constant-light or direct-field controls reproduce the accepted output at equal or lower complete cost.
replay_scope: Algebraic integrity and counterexamples only; no physical validation or capability promotion.
